audit.whatIsWrong: Four of the seven chart rows contradicted the why written directly underneath them. Levels 4-5 were marked Aurora above a why that says 'freeze and farm safe through 4-5'; Level 6 was marked Ziggs above a why calling it 'your one clean all-in'; first item and two items were marked Aurora above whys saying Liandry's out-pokes her and full artillery 'zones you out completely'. Aurora's win rate is 46.51%.
audit.why: Bouncing Bomb is 6/5.5/5/4.5/4s against Twofold Hex's 9/8.5/8/7.5/7s, so he throws half again as often from level 1. Satchel Charge (20/18/16/14/12s) and Hexplosive Minefield (a flat 16s at every rank) both refresh faster than Across the Veil's 22s, which is precisely why 4-5 is his. Level 6 is Aurora's because Between Worlds is the only tool that crosses terrain into him.
audit.corrected: Chart set as one atomic group to Ziggs / Skill / Aurora / Ziggs / Aurora / Ziggs / Ziggs — identical to the packet chart — with ratings 3/5/6/3/6/3/3.

audit.whatIsWrong: Not one spike or stage carried a cooldown, and the level-6 line named 'Between the Worlds', which is not an ability.
audit.why: Aurora's R is Between Worlds, 140/120/100s. Ziggs's spikes are Bouncing Bomb from level 1 (6s), both zoning tools by 4-5 (20s and a flat 16s), Mega Inferno Bomb at 120/95/70s, and the Liandry's item timing.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into every stage, spike and trade line; Between Worlds spelled correctly and given its 140s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page's central claim, repeated in spikes[0].text and whys[0], was that 'Bouncing Bomb out-ranges your entire kit'. Riot's data gives Bouncing Bomb 850 range and Twofold Hex 900. Separately, Satchel Charge's percent-max-health component was never stated, so the page's implicit resistance answer is wrong.
audit.why: His real, verifiable edge at level 1 is rate of fire, not reach: 6s against 9s. Satchel Charge is flagged percentHealth at 1000 range with a knockback that also displaces Ziggs, and champ-data/_kits/_missing/aurora.json raises it as resistances-invalidated. Short Fuse is an auto-attack reset whose cooldown shortens every time he casts, which is the burst tell the missing-interactions file flags.
audit.corrected: Both range claims replaced with the 6s-vs-9s cooldown gap. Satchel Charge's percent max health now stated in dontsFull[0], breakdown.cooldowns and spikes[3].text; Short Fuse's reset added to dontsFull[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: The cooldown block tracked only Satchel Charge and gave it no number, and treated Hexplosive Minefield as an afterthought.
audit.why: Hexplosive Minefield is a FLAT 16s at every rank — it never gets shorter with points, which is unusual and worth knowing, and it is the tool that actually stops the leap path. Both his zoning cooldowns (20s and 16s) are shorter than Across the Veil (22s), so the 'bait both then leap' plan only works once per rotation.
audit.corrected: All three numbers written in, with the explicit statement that both of his tools come back before your escape does.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Between the Worlds' in phases[4].why and breakdown.late, and untargetability asserted for Between Worlds in spikes[2].text, mid, late, whys[4] and wants.you[1].
audit.why: Riot's Between Worlds text describes damage, a slow, and an area Aurora can teleport across — no untargetability. The same false attribute was corrected on Aurora's Zac and Pantheon pages in this slice.
audit.corrected: Name fixed; every untargetability claim rewritten as crossing terrain or crossing the rift, which is what the description supports.

edits.before: This is where Ziggs reclaims it for good. With Liandry's and Rylai's online his artillery poke zones whole sections of the map — Q chunks you on cooldown, Satchel Charge (W) knocks you off any engage, and Hexplosive Minefield (E) walls your W and R approach with slows. Your poke-and-blink pattern has to get into range, and a fed Ziggs simply never lets you. Don't solo him in the open; group with vision, fight near walls where Between Worlds' untargetability and wall-crossing matter, and let your frontline eat the bombs so you can W-flank his backline instead of facetanking the siege.

notes: Packet suspectNames are BOTH false positives, as the packet warns they can be: 'Stack Spirit Abjuration' (wants.you[2]) and 'Drop Hexplosive Minefield' (wants.foe[1]) are the real Riot names with an English verb in front of them. No name change was needed for either; I edited wants.foe[1] only to add cooldowns. Range discrepancy left unresolved on purpose: Riot lists Bouncing Bomb at 850 and Twofold Hex at 900, which contradicts the page's 'out-ranges your entire kit', but Bouncing Bomb bounces and Riot's one-line description says nothing about how far the bounces travel past the cast point. Rather than assert either that he out-ranges her or that she out-ranges him, I rebuilt those lines on the cooldown gap (6s vs 9s), which is fully verifiable. Someone should confirm Bouncing Bomb's effective post-bounce reach and settle it. Also unverified and therefore preserved rather than amplified: Across the Veil resetting on takedown, which four strings on this page rely on.
